name: closed-loop
description: Attack one target, fix each proven flaw, and attack again. A finding is verified when the same attack predicate settles false on evidence that is newer than the deploy.

task.goal: Test reference-environment at {{target.url}}. For each flaw that you can prove, call SubmitProof with the predicate of its technique and the recorded tool calls. Raise one finding for each proof that settles. Do not change the target and do not fix anything. Do not contact a host other than {{target.url}}. Before a destructive step, request authorization and wait for the decision.

spec.goal: For each finding that you are given, fix its cause in the manifests of this repository and open one merge request for the finding. Name the finding in the merge request. Merge it when the pipeline is green. After the deploy, read the health signal of the service through the connector prometheus-refenv. Hold the signal for the hold time of the service. When the signal fails, revert your merge and leave the finding open. Fix one service at a time. Do not attack.

task.goal: Run the attack of each finding again on reference-environment at {{target.url}}, with the same predicate. Collect new evidence. Call SubmitProof for each predicate. Look for a second path to the same flaw. Do not fix anything. Do not contact a host other than {{target.url}}. Before a destructive step, request authorization and wait for the decision.
